svg.text: SERENITY-CLASS TILTROTOR UAV · BUILD GUIDE · REV T+
PRINT CARGO, TILT-DRIVE AND GEAR PARTS
Interior parts shown with the shells hidden
doors, latch, servo brackets, door tray,
Print the tilt brackets, worms, and wheels; the worm turns the wheel freely by hand.
Print the starboard brake guide from its own STL; it is a mirror, not a copy.
Print the four gear bays from the *_print.stl files; label each corner.
Print the cargo doors, latch brackets and cranks, door horns, and servo brackets.
Print the twin pack tray, sleds and gate, chin node shelf, GPS ring, FPV bezel, and door tray.
The winch has no hull-frame STLs yet; print it from the PRINT-CARGO-WINCH-* rows. It is not shown.
